tools.name: Write My PRD
tools.description: Write My PRD uses a ChatGPT‑based prompt engine that turns your high‑level ideas, goals, and user needs into a fully formatted Product Requirements Document, letting you skip the manual outlining and get a draft ready instantly.
bullets: Tailored PRD templates auto‑populate sections like scope, user stories, and success metrics
One‑click feedback integration lets you refine the draft with existing content

tools.name: Brilworks PRD Generator
tools.description: Brilworks’ AI extracts key product concepts from your input and builds a complete, market‑aware PRD, so you can focus on strategy while the tool handles structure and feature suggestions.
bullets: Auto‑generates user stories and competitive analysis based on entered product vision
Exports ready‑to‑share PRD files aligned with agile sprint planning

tools.name: Signlz
tools.description: Signlz lets you describe a product idea in a single prompt and instantly produces a polished PRD, technical spec, and linked task list that can be pushed to your favorite project‑management tool.
bullets: Unified studio creates PRD, specs, and task breakdowns in one flow
AI‑driven editing refines wording and adds missing sections on the fly

tools.name: GetBash PRD Generarot
tools.description: GetBash accepts raw inputs—webpages, meeting notes, or audio—and converts them into a structured PRD, removing the need to manually transcribe or organize scattered information.
bullets: Multi‑source ingestion (URLs, audio, notes) builds a complete PRD automatically
Chat‑based editor lets you tweak sections instantly and share drafts with teammates

tools.name: ChatPRD
tools.description: ChatPRD acts as a product‑manager‑focused AI copilot that guides you through PRD creation with role‑based prompts, real‑time CPO feedback, and template libraries for fast, consistent documentation.
bullets: Interactive coaching surfaces gaps and suggests improvements as you write
Rich template library + custom uploads let you generate PRDs in minutes

tools.name: Wisary
tools.description: Embedded in Confluence, Wisary helps product teams generate PRDs without leaving their existing docs, turning prompts into structured specs and automatically linking them to user stories and test plans.
bullets: AI works directly in Confluence to avoid context‑switching while drafting PRDs
Automatic conversion of PRD sections into actionable engineering tickets

tools.name: Aigents
tools.description: Aigents provides a dedicated PRD generation agent that takes your product brief and outputs a ready‑to‑edit document, streamlining the workflow for PMs who need quick, consistent specs.
bullets: Specialized PRD agent produces a formatted draft from a simple brief
Web‑based, no installation required—start generating PRDs instantly

tools.name: ProdPad CoPilot
tools.description: ProdPad’s AI CoPilot can draft PRDs based on your product strategy, pull in relevant ideas and feedback, and keep the document synced with roadmaps and OKRs for seamless execution.
bullets: AI drafts PRD sections aligned with existing roadmaps and objectives
Keeps PRD linked to ideas, feedback, and backlog items for continuous updates
